discription: A shimmering, evolving pad sound created by modulating a sine wave with a slower sine wave, giving it a gentle pulse.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, modFreq=0.5, modDepth=0.1;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.5, 1.0, 0.7, 1.5, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var modulator = SinOsc.kr(modFreq) * modDepth;    sig = SinOsc.ar(freq * (1 + modulator));    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
